title: EasyJet backs $7.7 billion Apollo takeover bid over Castlelake offer
title_zh: EasyJet 支持 Apollo 77 亿美元收购 Castlelake 收购要约
summary: STORY: A takeover battle for one of Europe's biggest airlines could be brewing.Apollo Global Management announced a $7.7 billion bid for easyJet on Friday.The U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：欧洲最大航空公司之一的收购战可能正在酝酿之中。阿波罗全球管理公司周五宣布以 77 亿美元收购易捷航空。

title: Corning (GLW) Lands Amazon Deal And Nvidia Tie Up For AI Fiber Expansion
title_zh: 康宁 (GLW) 与亚马逊达成协议，与 Nvidia 合作拓展 AI 光纤业务
summary: Corning (NYSE:GLW) has signed a multi billion dollar agreement with Amazon to expand US production of optical fiber products used in AI data centers.
summary_zh: 康宁公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GLW）与亚马逊签署了一项价值数十亿美元的协议，以扩大美国人工智能数据中心使用的光纤产品的生产。

title: Apollo hijacks easyJet takeover with £5.7bn bid, trumping Castlelake
title_zh: 阿波罗以 57 亿英镑的出价击败卡斯尔莱克，劫持易捷航空收购
summary: The budget airline easyJet has swung behind a £5.7 billion (€6.6bn) takeover proposal from the US private equity giant Apollo, abandoning its support for a rival American bidder days after agreeing to that offer.View on euronews
summary_zh: 廉价航空公司易捷航空 (easyJet) 转而支持美国私募股权巨头阿波罗 (Apollo) 的 57 亿英镑（66 亿欧元）收购提议，并在同意该提议几天后放弃了对美国竞争对手的支持。

title: Apple Announces $30 billion Multi-year Chip Deal With Broadcom (AVGO)
title_zh: 苹果宣布与博通 (AVGO) 达成价值 300 亿美元的多年期芯片协议
summary: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) is one of the 10 Best Data Center Stocks to Buy in July. On July 8, Apple announced a multi-year chip deal with Broadcom expected to exceed $30 billion, the largest U.S. manufacturing commitment to date, CNBC reported.
summary_zh: Broadcom Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：AVGO）是 7 月最值得买入的 10 只数据中心股票之一。据 CNBC 报道，7 月 8 日，苹果宣布与博通达成一项多年期芯片协议，预计金额将超过 300 亿美元，这是美国迄今为止最大的制造业承诺。

title: EasyJet Gets Surprise Apollo Offer That Beats Castlelake Bid
